model.name: PtyBridge.reapOrphans
model.description: At server boot, enumerate all tmux sessions matching the sm_* grouped-session prefix and kill-session each — at boot no PTY is attached (prior process died) so every sm_* is a safe-to-reap orphan; a fresh boot leaves zero orphan sm_* sessions. Confined to PtyBridge.ts + a server-boot hook. Design-ahead (expert self-audit root-cause): per-ws cleanup kills sm_* on onExit/close/error (0 in-session orphans) but a restart/crash WITH an attached terminal orphans the session (tmux outlives node -> cleanup never runs) -> accumulation over deploys (the sm_p* in Tron IMG_4605). Expert points its impl here (marker on the reapOrphans decl); NOT self-minted (#126).
